name: Add array bounds contract (Calor)
prompt:
In Contract.calr, add bounds-checking contracts to the `GetElement` function (f003). Add preconditions ensuring the index is within bounds:

§Q (>= index 0)
§Q (< index length)
§Q (> length 0)

The function should look like:
§F{f003:GetElement:pub}
  §I{i32:index}
  §I{i32:length}
  §O{i32}
  §Q (>= index 0)
  §Q (< index length)
  §Q (> length 0)
  §R (? (and (>= index 0) (< index length)) index (- 0 1))

IMPORTANT: The function ID f003 must NOT change.
